prompt: A warm painted animated film in the same elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous medium shot. Preserve the adult chef, her face, ivory jacket, olive apron, warm lighting and painted texture. A quiet natural moment checking the pastry batch at the open oven. She holds the rigid baking tray with BOTH hands for the ENTIRE shot, one hand on each side, using the SAME small folded WHITE oven cloth. The cloth remains small, folded and white. The olive apron stays tied around her waist. She gently draws the supported tray a short distance towards herself, looks carefully down at the tartlets, and gives a subtle satisfied nod. Then she holds the tray still. Both hands keep exactly the same secure grip on the tray throughout. The tray remains level. All tartlets remain planted on the tray. The oven and open door remain fixed and solid. Restrained natural breathing, stable face and hands. No release of the tray, no change of cloth, no lifting fabric, no wiping the face.
